title: Benchmark release (tempdoc 623)
description: A projection over cohort-identical jseval runs: one config/commit/hardware, ranged over N corpora. The search-quality register headline and relevance-ratchet floors are projections of this object, not hand-typed forks.

release_id.description: Required, date-suffixed human label (e.g. 667-external-baselines-2026-07-01). `jseval release` refuses to compose without one matching this pattern (tempdoc 683).

composed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC; passed in by the caller (scripts cannot call Date.now).

default_mode.description: The production-default search mode whose metrics are the per-corpus headline.

config_cohort_key.description: SHA over the config-global manifest subset (tempdoc 623 T-1/U1).

measured.description: Per-dataset projected headline. Key = dataset slug.

metrics.description: Per-mode family-keyed metric map (quality nDCG + promoted CE-stage latency) — NOT nDCG-hard-wired (tempdoc 623 T-3/favor-1).

run_metrics.description: Per-run metric family (tempdoc 640): throughput + resident footprint. Optional — present only when ingest ran / footprint resolved.

upstream_revision.description: Upstream corpus revision/version pin when the run's corpus identity carries one (record-if-available; null until a fetcher records it — tempdoc 683).

withheld.description: Explicitly withheld default-mode claims: no quality metric or regression floor. Source runs and non-default ablations remain in the release.

ablations.description: Labelled non-default-mode measurements per dataset (heterogeneous research log; never the headline).

external_baselines.description: Cited (immutable) published baselines shown side-by-side; never a projection of our runs.

leak.description: Optional per-dataset recall-leak projection (tempdoc 683): measured `staged_recall_accounting` leak_rate per corpus, sourced by `jseval release` when the composed runs carry the projection. leak-gate-baselines.v1.json's `current_release` pointer prefers this section over its `fallback_baselines`.

utility.description: Optional per-corpus agent-utility projection (tempdoc 683): measured condition-C floor per corpus. utility-ratchet-baselines.v1.json's `current_release` pointer prefers this section over its `fallback_baselines`. Not yet sourced by `jseval release` (utility records come from the agent-eval pipeline, not run summaries).

sources.description: Artifact provenance (tempdoc 802): which eval runs this release was projected from, one entry per member in compose order. `cohort` records the CONFIG a release was measured under (git sha, hashes, hardware, model fingerprints); this records the ARTIFACTS, so the published numbers can be re-scored or re-derived later. Absent on releases composed before 802 — `715-rebaseline-2026-07-16` is the case that motivated it: its run dirs were cleaned up and its numbers became impossible to reproduce.

dataset.description: Canonical dataset slug of the contributing run.

run_dir.description: Repo-relative run directory when resolvable, else absolute. Best-effort pointer, not an identity — paths rot.

summary_sha256.description: sha256 over the run's summary.json bytes — the identity that survives the directory being deleted.
